title: HDB Existing Building
footprint_coordinates: GeoJSON longitude/latitude, WGS84; verified bounds within Singapore.
join_rule: Exact BLK_NO + POSTAL_COD for verified cluster blocks. Route stops without postal require the exact block and its verified OneMap point inside one unique footprint. ST_COD is an HDB street code, not a street name; do not join it to the property street text.
height_rule: max_floor_lvl from existing HDB Property Information join, multiplied by illustrative 3 m per storey. Missing storeys remain null.
